added_failures_note: Derived from the source manifest baseline_suite and after_suite log FAILED ids and completed summary lines; both logs have zero failures. Broader importer deltas were separately adjudicated by the coordinator and are not silently conflated with this scoped measure.
assertion_independence: No regression assertion is tautologically coupled to a test-supplied input: explicit exception/status/stage literals check serialization, while the actual ticker and subprocess tests derive expected stages and identities independently; receipt snapshot equality is supplemental persistence evidence and is not credited as proof of correct receipt contents.

assertion_review.failure_conditions: Refusing acquisition fails acquired; swallowing/replacing the exception fails caught.value is error; missing or delayed write fails the pre-release snapshot; a changed receipt fails snapshot equality; wrong status, stage, reason or current pid fails the respective fixed expectation; reversed timestamps fail ordering; failing to release the lock fails the final probe. Reinstating the missing writer reddens the receipt assertion, as delivery-negative.log shows.
An unacquired stub seat raises before adding an attempt; this is fixture validation, not independent lifecycle coverage.

An ended supervisor fails poll; no replacement or repeated replacement fails exactly-two actual subprocess pids; mislinked old/new pids, supervisor pid, exit code or last stage fail comparisons against independently observed subprocess identities and known exit path; restarting after the lease fails elapsed bound; no held seat fails live probe; lost termination receipt or incorrect termination status fails stopped assertions. Removing restart persistence or the supervisor restart would redden these assertions.
Failed acquisition fails acquired; removing the record/watcher identity check writes an old-producer exit into the successor registration and fails the absent-exit assertion.

Swallowing the injected wait exception fails pytest.raises; removing actual waiting-stage annotation fails the exposed-record stage expectation; treating an opaque handle as a mutable dict raises TypeError instead of the expected RuntimeError; incorrect status or reason fails fixed literals.

Failed acquisition or release fails truth assertions; deleting the placement receipt write leaves no snapshot and fails status/stage checks; overwriting that receipt on outer teardown fails final equality.

Failed reacquisition fails acquired; failing to clear an earlier same-process exit fails exit_record is None; classifying same-process reentry as a replacement creates restart_record and fails absence.

0.reason: last_stage is recorded for dict registrations, which is every registration the producer writes; an opaque-handle provider is a test seam only
